messages:
jon: Heads-up: saw a duplicate POST in prod today. Traced it to the python SDK replaying a request after httpx timeout but dropping the Idempotency-Key.

maya: yikes. which sdk version?

jon: 0.12.6. repro sketch:
```py
async with AsyncClient() as c:
    hdrs = {"Idempotency-Key": key}
    try:
        await c.post('/v1/create', json=data, headers=hdrs, timeout=3.0)
    except httpx.ReadTimeout:
        pass
```
client times out, upstream replay-controller retries ~1s later without the header -> duplicate.

liam: probable bug: replay serializes Request and reconstructs without preserving custom headers casing; header gets lost when de/serializing headers map.

infra-bot: logs: [1785550050] ReadTimeout at edge; [1785550062] replay-controller retried; backend resource id=lmno456 created on retry.

maya: proposed fixes: always preserve Idempotency-Key case-insensitively on all retry/replay code paths; add config `replay_on_client_timeout=false` by default; expose RetryPolicy dataclass so users can opt-in. Add a test that simulates httpx.ReadTimeout and asserts single create when key present.

liam: I'll open a small PR to deep-copy headers during serialization and normalize keys to lowercase. Also add unit + integration test.

jon: workaround until patch: set client.default_headers['Idempotency-Key']=uuid4() or disable replay.

maya: agree. also document that 499/408 should not trigger replay; only 5xx by default.

liam: PR #2410 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2410 — includes fix + tests.

jon: verified staging after PR. duplicate gone. thanks! :rocket:
